title: 第14章 皮痒了？欠揍？第15章 无人能够得到的工作
content_zh:
第十四章 皮痒了？欠揍？
击败血脉战士已经是几乎无法完成的任务，击败称雄人类的最强三大血脉之一的精灵王初级觉醒血脉战士，这个罗德里格斯老师还真是够敢想的。
乾劲轻声的感叹，没有真正亲眼见过血脉战士的人，是根本不知道血脉战士有多么的强大！当真正见过了血脉战士的强大，若还有人抱着可以打败血脉战士的想法，真不知道是说他天真好？还是说他妄想？
初级觉醒，哪怕仅仅只是初级觉醒的精灵王血脉战士……乾劲轻轻的摇头，这个世界就是这样的不公平，有些人单单只是因为自己血脉的力量觉醒，立刻拥有了无比光辉的未来前景，他们不需要自己是天才，单单因为血脉力量的觉醒，就比这世上的天才还要可怕。
乾劲偷偷看了看自己的双手跟身体，轻轻的叹了一口气，自己也是姓乾的，怎么那次测试血脉战士觉醒的时候就偏偏失败了呢？搞得只能前来这里寻找藏宝图中的战士秘籍，即便无法成为一名无敌的血脉战士，至少也可以获得强大的力量，不被别人看扁，如果幸运的话，即便无法战胜初级觉醒的三大血脉战士，那么说不定还是有机会，打败初级狼王血脉之类的血脉战士吧？
“乾劲，乾劲……”罗德里格斯在乾劲眼前连连晃动手掌：“想什么呢？怎样？我真的认为你未来会成为一名伟大的战士！”
乾劲轻轻笑着回望罗德里格斯，如果不想向家里那些看不起自己的人证明，即便我的血脉无法苏醒，我依然是一名伟大的战士，就不会出现在这个偏僻的奥克兰城市，而是出现在一座繁华的城市中，去做一名商人了。
“好啊。”乾劲很有兴趣的看着罗德里格斯：“不知道老师，有什么方法，我该如何配合？”
“首先，你要参加试炼。”罗德里格斯认真的表情突然变得有些茫然：“然后……然后……”
乾劲看着罗德里格斯然后了半天也没有下文，笑了笑：“好了，老师我知道了。真的感谢你，试炼我参加就是了，时间订好了到时候通知我。”
罗德里格斯那有点茫然的脸上绽放出了开心的笑容：“好，这才对嘛。”
乾劲惦记着早点买上床单跟重新找份工作，能够更早的回到房间，去研究那古怪的帽子：“老师，我先走了。您忙。”
离开老师宿舍，乾劲看着不远处站着的一个人，开始怀疑难道今天不宜出门？平日里除了上课，锻炼，打工，睡觉就几乎没有其他的事情，怎么今天事情特别多？
凯萨斯，那个曾经带领着几个小弟，把罗林揍了一顿，威胁其不准追校花，在切磋课程上被乾劲打成猪头的战士学员，在经过一段时间的休息，再一次出现在了校园中。
凯萨斯的身材修长，除了稍微有点鹰钩的鼻子，整个人也说的上是帅气英俊，他身后跟着四名高矮不同的学员，见到乾劲顿时充满了挑衅。
不算宽敞的通道，凯萨斯连同手下在道路上一字横向排开，将道路堵得严严实实，眼神中除了挑衅还是挑衅。
乾劲看着身材略高过自己，一身锦缎战士服的凯萨斯挑了挑眉毛，轻轻活动的肩膀，转动着脖子笑着说道：“挡我的道？皮痒了？想挨揍？”
拳头的关节被捏的噼里啪啦响个不停，配合着乾劲脸上三分不耐烦的笑容，令凯萨斯跟他的三名手下同时打了一个寒战，想起了那次乾劲在学院中唯一的一次全力出手，用势如疯虎来形容，一点都不为过。
“乾劲……你……你别得意。”凯萨斯明显的向后退了一步，紧张令话语有些结巴：“我，我不怕你。我今天是来告诉你，下午晚饭以后，你……你来学院后面的小树林，咱们好好算算你我之间的事情。”
奥克兰魔法与战士学院的小树林，那是学校里几乎连老师都公认的，专门供学生们私下解决争端的地方。

乾劲皱皱眉笑了笑，这些不需要为生活奔波，每天吃饱了无聊的学员，学院里就该给他们加课！
“怎么？不敢？”凯萨斯下巴跳动了数下：“怕了？”
乾劲无力的笑，凯萨斯这种货色，自己让他一只手打他都轻松加愉快，真不知道他哪里来的勇气，还敢跑到面前来跳？有时间自己去打点工多赚点，或者回房间研究那顶帽子不是更好？还去小树林？
“让一下。”乾劲抬手一推凯萨斯，那可以将蛮牛鲁迪干翻的力量，直接让凯萨斯身体失去平衡，屁股跟地面来了一个无比亲热的接触，溅起些许的尘土。
凯萨斯看着乾劲那远去的背影，不甘心的喊道：“乾劲！晚饭后小树林。不然，你会后悔的。”
乾劲无力的摇着头，举起手掌随意摆动：“皮痒了，找你妈揍你，我没空每次都替你妈教训你，又不给我钱。”
“你……”凯萨斯用力的锤了地面一拳恨恨道：“你会后悔，你不去小树林一定会后悔！”
“老大，那咱们……”
“急什么？”凯萨斯起身拍着屁股上的尘土，表情很是自信：“我一定有办法让他去小树林！这次，我找了帮手，非要把他打的躺在床上休息不行！”
“老大……他好像很厉害啊……”
“怕什么？厉害什么？”凯萨斯对着地面恨恨吐了口唾沫：“他不过是战士系一年级排名第十能打的人，我这次找的人也是前十的！乾劲他一个前十垫底的，还怕他什么？”
“老大英明。”
“老大说的对。”
三名凯萨斯的连连点头，奥克兰魔法与战士学院每一个级部都会选出十名最能打的，虽然都是前十，但前十之间也经常会有很大的战斗能力诧异，比如有时候第八跟第九，名次是挨着的，可是第八可以瞬间把第九打败，这种事情也不是没有。
乾劲虽然进入了一年前最能打的前十，但排名垫底，说是勉强凑数都有可能，真找到前面的排名战士，打他定然很是轻松简单。
ps:书评区见到了好多来自同一地方的朋友，高楼这里拜谢了，谢谢大家，说真的，真的很感动。已经很久没这么感动过了，你们让我体会到了温情，谢谢。

content_en:
Chapter 14 Is it itchy? Deserve a beating?
Defeating the bloodline warriors is an almost impossible task. To defeat the Elf King's junior awakened bloodline warriors, one of the three strongest bloodlines that dominate mankind, this teacher Rodriguez is really brave enough to think about it.
Ganjin sighed softly, people who have never seen a bloodline warrior with their own eyes have no idea how powerful a bloodline warrior is! After truly seeing how powerful the bloodline warriors are, if someone still has the idea that they can defeat the bloodline warriors, do they think they are being naive? Or is he delusional?
The primary awakening, even just the primary awakening warrior of the Elf King's bloodline... Ganjin shook his head gently. The world is so unfair. Some people immediately have extremely bright future prospects just because of the awakening of the power of their bloodline. They don't need to be geniuses. Just because of the awakening of the power of bloodline, they are more terrifying than the geniuses in this world.
Ganjin secretly looked at his hands and body, and sighed softly. He was also named Gan, so why did he fail when he tested the awakening of the bloodline warrior? I have no choice but to come here to look for the warrior secrets in the treasure map. Even if I can't become an invincible blood warrior, I can at least gain powerful power and not be looked down upon by others. If I'm lucky, even if I can't defeat the three primary awakened blood warriors, I might still have a chance to defeat the primary blood warriors like the Wolf King bloodline, right?
"Gengjin, Ganjin..." Rodriguez shook his palms in front of Ganjin's eyes: "What are you thinking about? How? I really think you will become a great warrior in the future!"
Gan Jin looked back at Rodriguez with a smile. If he didn't want to prove to those who looked down on him at home that even if my bloodline could not be revived, I was still a great warrior, I would not have appeared in this remote Auckland city, but in a prosperous city to be a businessman.
"Okay." Ganjin looked at Rodriguez with great interest: "I don't know, teacher, what method can I use? How can I cooperate?"
"First, you have to participate in the trial." Rodriguez's serious expression suddenly turned a little confused: "Then...then..."
Ganjin looked at Rodriguez and said nothing for a long time. He smiled and said, "Okay, teacher, I understand. Thank you very much. I will just participate in the trial. You will let me know when the time is set."
Rodriguez's somewhat dazed face burst into a happy smile: "Okay, this is right."
Ganjin was thinking about buying bed sheets and finding a new job early so that he could return to the room earlier and study that weird hat: "Teacher, I'm leaving first. You are busy."
After leaving the teacher's dormitory, Ganjin looked at a person standing not far away and began to wonder if it was not a good time to go out today? On weekdays, there is almost nothing else to do except going to class, exercising, working, and sleeping. Why are there so many things today?
Caesars, the warrior student who once led several juniors, beat up Luo Lin, threatened him not to chase the school belle, and was beaten to a pig's head by his enthusiasm during the competition class, appeared on campus again after a period of rest.
Caesars has a slender figure, and apart from his slightly aquiline nose, he is also handsome and handsome. He is followed by four students of different heights, and he is full of provocation when he sees his enthusiasm.
Not counting the spacious passage, Caesars and his men lined up horizontally on the road, blocking the road tightly, with provocation in their eyes.
Gan Jin looked at Caesars, who was slightly taller than him and dressed in a brocade warrior uniform, raised his eyebrows, moved his shoulders slightly, turned his neck and said with a smile: "Getting in my way? Are you itchy? Do you want to be beaten?"
The joints of his fists were being pinched so much that they kept crackling, and coupled with the impatient smile on Qianjin's face, Kesas and his threeThe famous subordinates shuddered at the same time, recalling the only time in the academy when they made a full-strength attack. To describe it as powerful as a crazy tiger is not an exaggeration.
"Go... you... don't be proud." Caesars took a step back obviously, his words stuttered due to nervousness: "I, I'm not afraid of you. I'm here to tell you today that after dinner in the afternoon, you... you come to the grove behind the college, and we can settle the matter between you and me."
The grove of Oakland Academy of Magic and Warriors is recognized by almost even the teachers in the school as a place specifically for students to resolve disputes privately.
Ganjin frowned and smiled. These students who don't need to run for a living and are bored every day should be given extra classes in the academy!
"What? Don't you dare?" Kaisas' chin twitched several times: "Are you afraid?"
Smiling weakly, a guy like Kesas can easily and happily let him hit him with one hand. I really don’t know where he got the courage to jump in front of him? If you have time, wouldn't it be better to do some work to earn more money, or go back to your room to study that hat? Going to the woods?
"Give me a moment." Ganjin raised his hand and pushed Caesars. The force that could knock over Rudy the Bull caused Caesars' body to lose balance. His butt made an extremely intimate contact with the ground, splashing some dust.
Kesas looked at Ganjin's retreating back and shouted unwillingly: "Gengjin! The woods after dinner. Otherwise, you will regret it."
Shaking his head weakly, he raised his palms and waved them casually: "If your skin is itchy, ask your mother to beat you. I don't have time to teach you a lesson for your mother every time, and you don't give me money."
"You..." Kesas punched the ground hard and said bitterly: "You will regret it. You will definitely regret it if you don't go to the grove!"
"Boss, then let's..."
"Why are you so anxious?" Caesars stood up and patted the dust on his butt, with a very confident expression on his face: "I will definitely find a way to get him to go to the woods! This time, I found a helper and beat him until he lay on the bed to rest!"
"Boss...he seems to be very powerful..."
"What are you afraid of? Why are you so powerful?" Kesas spat bitterly on the ground: "He is only the tenth-ranked first-year fighter in the warrior department. The person I am looking for this time is also in the top ten! He is the bottom of the top ten in terms of motivation, why should you be afraid of him?"
"The boss is wise."
"The boss is right."
The three Caesars nodded repeatedly. Each division of Oakland Magic and Warrior Academy will select the ten most capable fighters. Although they are all in the top ten, there are often great differences in combat ability among the top ten. For example, sometimes the eighth and ninth are ranked next to each other, but the eighth can defeat the ninth in an instant. This kind of thing is not unheard of.
Although Ganjin entered the top ten of the best fighters a year ago, he was ranked at the bottom. It was possible to barely make up the numbers. If he really found the ranked fighter in front of him, it would be very easy to beat him.
